children: OmniAb reported first-quarter 2026 revenue of $3.99 million, up 78.3% from $2.24 million a year earlier. Net loss was $15.73 million, compared with $16.53 million, while diluted loss per share was $0.12 versus $0.14.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net loss”. ³ Reported as “loss per share, basic and diluted”.
Nine-month revenue rose 209% to $31.8 million, driven mainly by milestone revenue, alongside growth in services and xPloration.
Nine-month xPloration revenue increased 165%, reflecting higher instrument sales and related consumables.
Active partners reached 111 and active programs reached 433, up from 107 and 407, respectively, at year-end 2025.
Partners had 34 active clinical, regulatory-review, or approved programs, including three approved products.
Nine-month service revenue grew 48% as work increased on antibody and ion-channel programs.
